payload: {"schema":1,"version":"0.0.51","date":"2026-10-17","lede":"The Theatre menu on the Z key, French and Chinese, a faster PBR Fast, curve profiles and Curve tool setups in the library, and the toolbar's tools in the right-click menu.","highlights":["Theatre menu","French and Chinese","Tools in the right-click menu","Lazy mouse card","Curves in the library"],"notesUrl":"https://klaysculpt.com/releases/0.0.51","windows":{"url":"https://github.com/c6ank/klay-releases/releases/download/0.0.51/Klay_Setup_0.0.51.exe","size":394640672,"sha512":"0d61cb99c83261ed76893cdef39f599fdae8794f3b58489b52fe419e48835b0e60d9d22f4a43c17a9aedfa59855edb09efea7d69eea6bcbc6715c48566645462"},"mac":{"version":"0.0.51","url":"https://github.com/c6ank/klay-releases/releases/download/0.0.51/Klay_0.0.51_macOS.dmg","size":507820468,"sha512":"79331dd80115711ae65507ac7c0108b6181a29db2c25dea378bc8fde09c4c028e88542871302cb3b35403c725edb29fa11646c53ecc630085e27998760dbf647"},"items":[{"g":"n","t":"Theatre menu","b":"An alternative to the radial hub for the Z key. Holding Z shows up to four rings of brushes, tools and functions above the cursor, and a shelf below it with pages, toggles, sliders and a search across the whole app.","w":["Settings \u203a Radial menu"]},{"g":"n","t":"French and Chinese","b":"Klay's menus, panels and messages are available in French and Simplified Chinese as well as English. The language changes immediately, without a restart. Names you gave to brushes, presets and objects are kept as they are.","w":["Settings \u203a Preferences \u203a Language"]},{"g":"n","t":"Tools in the right-click menu","b":"The viewport's right-click menu has a Tools entry that lists the tools of the toolbar's Tools section with their icons. Its header switch turns the lazy mouse on or off, and Length sets how far the brush trails the pointer. Q still toggles it, and holding Q while dragging sets the length. The longest leash is now twice as long as before.","w":["Brush \u203a Lazy mouse"]},{"g":"n","t":"Curves in the library","b":"The library has a Curves category with two views: Profiles, the cross-sections saved in the Curve tool's My profiles, and Curve tools, complete Curve tool setups.","w":["Library \u203a Curves","Curve tool \u203a Curve tools \u203a Save"]},{"g":"i","t":"Faster PBR Fast","b":"PBR Fast now uses a much lighter shader, which raises the frame rate in close-ups that fill the screen, on the desktop and in VR. It keeps the scene lights, shadows, environment lighting, ambient occlusion, vertex paint, the specular colour and a steady emission.","w":["Material \u203a Shading model \u203a PBR Fast"]},{"g":"i","t":"Clearer object selection","b":"With the Select tool, or while holding V, the object under the cursor and the objects caught by a selection rectangle are outlined, while selected objects keep their fill colour. The outline is hidden where another object is in front.","w":["Toolbar \u203a Select"]},{"g":"i","t":"Undock the tool card","b":"The active tool card has an undock button in its header. Undocked, the card docks on the other side of the window, or floats where its header is dropped, and stays visible on every sidebar tab. On the Material and Lighting tabs, the tab's own card undocks into the same place. Its top handle sets the height and the handle on its inner edge sets the width. The same button returns it to the sidebar.","w":["Sidebar \u203a Tool card \u203a Undock"]},{"g":"i","t":"Shorter Symmetry section","b":"The Symmetry section of the right-click menu shows your three most used commands, like Topology; its count button opens the full list. The two Mirror directions are now direct entries.","w":["Viewport \u203a Right-click \u203a Symmetry"]},{"g":"i","t":"Gizmo outer ring scales on all three axes","b":"The Gizmo's outer ring now scales the selection uniformly on all three axes, replacing the screen-plane rotation. The larger ring gives finer control, and scaling up has no upper limit.","w":["Toolbar \u203a Gizmo"]},{"g":"i","t":"Gizmo pivot buttons: Lock, Center and Edit pivot","b":"The Gizmo's padlock is now three buttons. Lock keeps the pivot on the object at its current point, so it moves with the object and clicks on the mesh no longer move it; unlocked, a click on the mesh places the pivot. Center returns the pivot to the centre of the object, and Edit pivot moves or turns the pivot without moving the model.","w":["Toolbar \u203a Gizmo"]},{"g":"i","t":"Invert zoom direction","b":"Two new options invert the zoom direction: one for the zoom drag and one for the mouse wheel. With the drag inverted, dragging up zooms in, as in Blender.","w":["Settings \u203a Navigation \u203a Speed"]},{"g":"i","t":"Middle-drag scrolls panels","b":"Dragging with the middle mouse button over a panel or list scrolls it with the cursor.","w":["Sidebar, Settings and lists"]},{"g":"i","t":"Brush size and strength step shortcuts","b":"Four new shortcuts step the brush size and strength up or down by one increment per press, for keyboards, tablet keys and controllers such as TourBox. They ship unassigned.","w":["Shortcuts \u203a Brush size up / down, Brush strength up / down"]},{"g":"i","t":"Pen side button as middle click","b":"The pen's side button can act as a middle click instead of a right click, so a tap no longer opens the viewport menu.","w":["Settings \u203a Tablet \u203a Pen side button"]},{"g":"i","t":"Default mask preset","b":"Right-click a Mask preset and choose Set as default mask. Klay starts on that preset, and pressing X always switches to it.","w":["Toolbar \u203a Mask \u203a Right-click a preset"]},{"g":"i","t":"Curve ribbons for poly modelling","b":"The Flat profile has two points, so a ribbon is one face wide, and Flip normal turns it to face the other way. With Linear on, Single edge leaves one edge at each corner instead of two, and an arrow on the selected corner drags out a bevel that gains edges as it grows. Moving a dot on a Linear curve no longer twists the rest of the curve.","w":["Curve tool \u203a Profile, Shape, Stroke & dots, Mesh"]},{"g":"i","t":"Order controls for curve objects","b":"A new Order section sets which mesh goes where along the curve. Random has a seed, No repeat, a maximum run and Balance. Sequence has a start, a step, a direction including ping-pong, and Repeat each. Pattern can be mirrored, shuffled per round and followed by gaps.","w":["Curve tool \u203a Objects \u203a Order"]},{"g":"i","t":"Max GPU use for ray tracing","b":"A new setting limits how much of the graphics card the ray-traced view uses, from 50% to 100%. A lower value leaves the system and other applications responsive, and the image converges proportionally slower.","w":["Lighting \u203a Raytrace \u203a Quality \u203a Max GPU use"]},{"g":"f","t":"Holding Ctrl with Trim, B-Scrape, Fill or Level now fills or cuts to the plane instead of raising ridges along the edges of a groove."},{"g":"f","t":"With Orbit around mouse point or Orbit around stroke point, orbiting, zooming or clicking from empty space now keeps the last pivot instead of jumping to an unrelated point."},{"g":"f","t":"On macOS, the FPS readout no longer sits on top of the toolbar."},{"g":"f","t":"In an orthographic view, the gizmo's rings, arms, planes and scale handles can be grabbed again, and dragging an object follows the cursor."},{"g":"f","t":"Duplicating an object inside a group now keeps the copy in that group."},{"g":"f","t":"Repeated Ctrl+D now repeats the last move, rotation or scale for several selected objects and for groups, not only for a single object."},{"g":"f","t":"A mask on a polygon mesh now also protects it from the Draw brush when its Spacing is set to Polywire."},{"g":"f","t":"The Mask mode no longer starts on the Concave preset when Klay opens."},{"g":"f","t":"Voxelize no longer crashes the application at high resolutions on some graphics cards."},{"g":"f","t":"The Boolean live preview now works when an operand is an instance made with Ctrl+D."},{"g":"f","t":"Boolean \"Tag as a zone set\" now creates a Boolean zone set holding A, B and the seam."},{"g":"f","t":"The Scene totals line in or an Image. Layers have a blend mode and an opacity, adjustment layers reshape the layers below them, and a Grading card adjusts the final result. Fill applies the brush to the whole mesh, the visible side or the selection in one click.","w":["Brush tab \u203a Mask \u203a Fill \u00b7 Sources \u00b7 Grading"],"k":["[X]"],"n":"Poly meshes"},{"g":"n","t":"Per-pixel Boolean preview","b":"The Boolean live preview can cut each object pixel by pixel along the intersection, so the cut edge matches the applied result instead of following whole triangles. The cut follows sculpting on either object as it happens, and a Sharpness setting trades edge detail for memory. The inside of a Subtract is lit, shadows follow the cut, and the settings are kept between sessions.","w":["Boolean \u203a Live preview \u203a Sharpness"],"n":"Poly meshes"},{"g":"n","t":"Sidebar tabs on both sides of the window","b":"Right-click a tab and choose Dock to left or Dock to right to move it to a second panel on the other side of the window. That panel can keep one tab open at its bottom, be shortened from its bottom edge, or be dragged out to float. The layout is kept between sessions.","w":["Sidebar \u203a tab row \u203a right-click"]},{"g":"n","t":"Klay and Community libraries","b":"The asset library has two online sources beside your own assets: Klay, with official assets, and Community, with assets shared by Klay artists. Get adds an asset to your library under Downloaded.","w":["Asset library \u203a Mine \u00b7 Klay \u00b7 Community"]},{"g":"n","t":"Alpha grading","b":"A Grading card under the alpha stamp remaps the alpha's values without editing the image, with a brightness curve, Levels, Brightness, Contrast, Gamma and Invert. The settings are saved with the brush, and the cursor preview shows the result.","w":["Brush tab \u203a Stroke & Falloff \u203a Alpha \u203a Grading \u00b7 Clay \u203a Stamp \u203a Grading"]},{"g":"n","t":"Preserve edge","b":"A Preserve edge slider keeps a stroke on the face it started on, so Flatten, Polish and the other brushes can cross a hard edge without rounding it. 0 turns it off.","w":["Brush tab \u203a Stamp & Falloff \u203a Advanced stroke \u203a Hard edges"]},{"g":"n","t":"Stroke curves (early work)","b":"A Curve group under a mesh's layers records each stroke made while it is selected as an editable curve. Drag its dots to reshape the stroke, hold B or M to change its size or intensity, and right-click a curve to bake it into a sculpt layer.","w":["Outliner \u203a Layers \u203a Curves \u00b7 Brush tab \u203a Curve \u00b7 Tool card \u203a Curve"],"n":"Poly meshes"},{"g":"n","t":"Invert brush","b":"An Invert brush switch in the Brush section makes a brush work inverted, as if Ctrl were held: a brush that adds material now carves. Holding Ctrl flips it back. The setting is saved with the brush.","w":["Brush tab \u203a Brush \u203a Invert brush"],"k":["[Ctrl]"]},{"g":"n","t":"Override unlit material","b":"Override unlit in a material's right-click menu makes every object use that material in Fast Unlit; the other shading modes keep each object's own material. The material menu now shows an icon beside each command.","w":["Material tab \u203a right-click a material \u203a Override unlit"]},{"g":"i","t":"Remesh is now Voxelize, with even quads","b":"Remesh is renamed Voxelize; its shortcut is unchanged. It now builds an even quad grid, similar to ZBrush DynaMesh, without shading rings on smooth shapes and with about half the polygons at the same Resolution. Project detail back places the original detail on a new sculpt layer.","w":["Outliner \u203a right-click \u203a Voxelize"],"k":["[Alt]+[R]"]},{"g":"i","t":"Boolean Union merges any number of meshes","b":"The Boolean panel has a new layout: the operation comes first, then the mesh that is kept, then the meshes it is combined with. Union accepts any number of meshes, added with Pick meshes, Add selected, or by pressing D with several meshes selected. Subtract and Intersect still use two meshes. The panel now matches the width of the sidebar.","w":["Outliner \u203a right-click \u203a Boolean"],"k":["[D]"],"n":"Poly meshes"},{"g":"i","t":"Sidebar tabs and view buttons","b":"The sidebar tabs are a row at the top of the panel: the current tab is named and opens a list of every tab, and the others sit beside it as icons. Ctrl+1 to Ctrl+0 open the tabs in order. The view buttons have their own strip beside the sidebar, which can be reordered, edited and moved to the other side.","w":["Sidebar"],"k":["[Ctrl]+[1]\u2026[0]"]},{"g":"i","t":"Mask is a toolbar mode","b":"Mask sits in the toolbar's mode row between Polygone and Paint. Tap X to switch to Mask and back, or hold X to mask only while it is held; Tab and the number keys work as in the other modes. Fill and Preview tiles sit beside the slots.","w":["Toolbar \u203a Mask"],"k":["[X]","[Tab]"]},{"g":"i","t":"Brush cursor on the surface","b":"The brush cursor lies on the surface at the size the brush deposits; it can wrap the surface, sit flat or stay a screen circle, and a brush with an alpha can show the alpha's shape. The Brush cursor settings are regrouped into Shape, Motion, Guides and Tessellation.","w":["Settings \u203a Brush cursor"]},{"g":"i","t":"Ray tracing for heavy scenes","b":"In Raytrace, each part of a mesh is traced at the detail it needs for its distance from the camera, so large scenes fit in GPU memory without leaving meshes out. Finer detail loads in the background shortly after the camera stops.","w":["Lighting \u203a Raytrace"]},{"g":"i","t":"Focus: display modes for the rest of the scene","b":"The Focus card has a Display section with the outliner's display modes: Shaded, Dither, X-ray, Fill, Wireframe and Bounds. Every object outside the selection takes that look while Focus is on.","w":["Top bar \u203a Focus \u203a settings card"]},{"g":"i","t":"Rounded colour picker","b":"The colour picker is now a rounded square with a draggable hue handle, and pure white and the full hue can be picked from its top corners. The ten saved colours are kept between sessions and across updates.","w":["Toolbar colour \u00b7 Paint \u00b7 Material \u00b7 Lighting"]},{"g":"i","t":"Card contrast","b":"A Card contrast slider in Settings \u203a Theme makes cards and sub-cards stand out more from the panel. At 0 % the interface looks as before.","w":["Settings \u203a Theme \u203a Interface colors"]},{"g":"i","t":"Smoother Gizmo moves","b":"Moving, rotating and scaling with the Gizmo runs at a steadier frame rate, without the periodic stutter.","w":["Gizmo tool"]},{"g":"i","t":"Smoother pen orbit","b":"Orbiting, panning and zooming with a pen is now as smooth as with a mouse. The Pen navigation card in Settings \u203a Tablet sets the amount, and on Wacom tablets Klay requests the highest report rate.","w":["Settings \u203a Tablet \u203a Pen navigation"]},{"g":"i","t":"Grab: push along the normal, scale and twist","b":"On a poly Grab brush, Ctrl with the left button pushes the area along the surface normal, Ctrl with the middle button scales it and Ctrl with the right button twists it. The combinations can be changed in the Shortcuts tab.","w":["Polygon tab \u203a Grab brush \u00b7 Settings \u203a Shortcuts \u203a Tools"]},{"g":"i","t":"Several Brush tab sections open","b":"Opening a section in the Brush tab no longer closes the others. Each section stays open or closed as you leave it.","w":["Brush tab"]},{"g":"i","t":"One Advanced stroke card","b":"The poly brush Advanced section is now part of the Advanced stroke card in Stamp & Falloff, as the Plane ops, Plane sampling, Hard edges and Crease sub-cards. Refresh every N dabs moved to Build-up.","w":["Brush tab \u203a Stamp & Falloff \u203a Advanced stroke"]},{"g":"i","t":"Tessellation Share values covers every setting","b":"Share values in the Tessellation section now applies to every tessellation setting, including Sizing, Follow creases and the limits. When it is off, each brush keeps its own values. The Shift smoothing brush has a Custom values switch that keeps its own settings even while values are shared.","w":["Brush tab \u203a Tessellation"]},{"g":"i","t":"Smooth / Faceted button","b":"The Smooth / Faceted function can be added to the sidebar buttons or to the action bar above the drawer. The button shows a circle in Smooth and a triangle in Faceted, and a click switches between them.","w":["Sidebar \u203a Add a button \u203a Display"]},{"g":"i","t":"Outliner expand arrow stays in place","b":"In compact mode, the arrow that expands an object card now stays where you clicked it, and the thumbnail appears to its right. The arrow points right when closed and down when open, like the other arrows in the outliner.","w":["Scene outliner"]},{"g":"i","t":"MatCap materials react to scene lights","b":"In PBR Fast, PBR and Raytrace, MatCap materials are now lit and shadowed by the scene lights; Fast Unlit still shows the plain matcap. Light and Shadows sliders in the MatCap section set the amount.","w":["Material tab \u203a MatCap"]},{"g":"i","t":"Ambient occlusion default","b":"The Ambient occlusion section has Set as default and Reset buttons, like the Volumetric and Weather sections. Set as default stores the current values; new scenes and new launches start from them, and Reset returns to them.","w":["Lighting tab \u203a Ambient occlusion"]},{"g":"i","t":"Curve ends extend by dragging","b":"Each free end of a curve now shows an arrow that follows the direction of the curve. Click it to add one point, or drag it to extend the curve along the arrow with evenly spaced points.","w":["Curve tool"]},{"g":"i","t":"Curves for edge modelling: Linear, Rings at dots, Flat profile","b":"Linear makes every segment of a curve straight, with a hard corner at each point. Rings at dots places a ring on every point, with a set number of rings per span between them, so the points act as holding edges under subdivision. The Flat profile, or any profile whose points lie on one line, now builds a single open sheet instead of two overlapping surfaces.","w":["Curve tool \u203a Stroke and Mesh sections, Profile"]},{"g":"i","t":"Asset library sections on a side rail","b":"The asset library now lists its sections in a rail on the left, grouped under Sculpt, Shade and Light, with the number of items in each. The tab row above the grid has been removed, and the window is wider to make room for the rail.","w":["Asset library"]},{"g":"i","t":"Retopology Sharp: Reset to default","b":"In Sharp mode, the Retopology window has a Reset to default button below the settings. It returns Target quads and the other Sharp settings to their default values.","w":["Outliner \u203a Retopology \u203a Sharp"]},{"g":"f","t":"Boolean: the live preview no longer hides random patches of the model."},{"g":"f","t":"Boolean: a model and its duplicate could not be combined. Selecting an object and its copy now runs the Boolean, and other copies of the same object are left unchanged."},{"g":"f","t":"Boolean: the live preview stayed on the shape from before a stroke. It now updates while either object is sculpted or reshaped."},{"g":"f","t":"Boolean: the panel keeps its two operands when they are deselected, and a new two-object selection replaces the operands left over from an earlier session."},{"g":"f","t":"Pen pressure: with pressure on Size, the brush cursor now shows the largest size a stroke can reach, and strokes no longer grow past it."},{"g":"f","t":"Tessellation: Subdivide all scrambled the UVs and seams of a mesh, which could throw vertices off the surface on the next Decimate all or stroke. UVs and seams are now kept."},{"g":"f","t":"Outliner: Filter scene did not find objects inside a collapsed group. It now searches every group."},{"g":"f","t":"Object display: a Dither object that was selected or hovered lost the colour picked for it. The Dither tint now holds under the selection highlight and the Focus dim, as X-ray already did."},{"g":"f","t":"Convert to poly left an unnamed copy of the shape that undo could not remove. The poly mesh is now named after the clay layer, which is hidden rather than deleted."},{"g":"f","t":"Convert to poly could leave most of the new mesh invisible, with only its wireframe and a small patch of surface showing. The whole mesh now draws."},{"g":"f","t":"Leaving a freeze sculpt without making a change could crash the app. It now returns to the clay layer as expected."},{"g":"f","t":"With a MatCap material, the viewport stayed in PBR and Fast Unlit or PBR Fast could not be selected. Every view mode can now be selected."},{"g":"f","t":"MatCap: Blender .exr matcaps did not load in Images mode. They now load, and the 27 matcaps from Blender 5.3 are included."},{"g":"f","t":"Tessellation: with Follow creases on, repeated strokes over the same area could leave lumps and spikes on the surface. Follow creases now only lines the edges up along the bend and no longer adds detail on it."},{"g":"f","t":"Tessellation: starting a stroke while the quick undo strip was stepping back could crash the app."},{"g":"f","t":"Sidebar on the left: the viewport readouts (view, lens, FPS, recording, render progress) stayed at the bottom left, under the sidebar. They now move to the bottom right."},{"g":"f","t":"Subdivision levels: stepping down a level reshaped the lower levels even without sculpting. Lower levels now change only where you sculpted."},{"g":"f","t":"Curve: undo after Bake removed the curve. Undo now restores the editable curve."},{"g":"f","t":"Grab and Elastique brushes cut off sharply at the edge of the brush circle and jumped in steps on long drags, and with symmetry a pull across the middle doubled up. The pull now fades smoothly and stays continuous."},{"g":"f","t":"Clay Grab no longer jumps in steps on a long drag, and Clay Elastique no longer stops pulling past the brush circle."},{"g":"f","t":"Material Bindings and other capsule buttons could turn into a solid highlight after switching or adding a set. The selected button now keeps its normal look."},{"g":"f","t":"Lattice: on a duplicated object, the cage could appear away from the object and did not deform it. It now fits and deforms the duplicate."},{"g":"f","t":"Camera tool: orbiting and moving the view in Raytrace was slower than with the tool off. It now runs at the same speed."},{"g":"f","t":"Navigation: with Orbit around mouse point on, orbiting and zooming now centre on the surface under the cursor."},{"g":"f","t":"Navigation: with Arcball and Trackball off, Orbit around stroke point and Orbit around mouse point made the view jump and spin away. Orbiting now turns around the point without jumping."},{"g":"f","t":"Combine selected turned quad meshes into triangles. The combined mesh now keeps the quads and polygons of each object."}]},{"version":"0.0.49","date":"2026-10-11","lede":"Retopology rebuilt for clean all-quad loops that follow the main edges; Pan speed and an Invert stroke key in Settings; orbit and zoom close in on the point you click; light edits can be undone; Undo always stays on Ctrl+Z.","highlights":["MatCap from an image","Follow creases","Export and import brushes","Sidebar on the left","16-bit clay","View and lens in the Viewport HUD"],"notesUrl":"https://klaysculpt.com/releases/0.0.49","items":[{"g":"n","t":"MatCap from an image","b":"A MatCap material can now use an imported image instead of the procedural look. A pastille at the top of the MatCap section switches between Procedural and Images; in Images mode, Browse loads a PNG, PSD, EXR or HDR file, with Rotation, Flip Y, Intensity and the same Color controls as the procedural look (posterize, hue, saturation, contrast, brightness, gamma). Sixteen-bit and floating-point files keep their full tonal range, so Blender-style matcaps read without banding. The matcap also renders in the raytracer, matching the viewport.","w":["Material \u203a Shading model \u203a MatCap \u203a Images"]},{"g":"n","t":"Follow creases","b":"Follow creases lays the edges of a tessellating stroke along the direction the surface bends, so the triangles form rows that follow cuts, folds and ridges instead of an even zig-zag. Along a fold the triangles stretch, which usually leaves fewer of them. On a sharp crease the vertices slide only along the line. Crease strength sets how strongly the edges follow the bend and how many more edges the bends receive; flat areas keep their density.","w":["Brush tab \u203a Tessellation \u203a Follow creases"]},{"g":"n","t":"Export and import brushes","b":"Export in the Brush tab saves the current preset, with its current settings and icon, as a .klaybrush file in a folder you choose. Import adds a .klaybrush file to the matching brush list (Clay, Stamp, Poly or Mask) and selects it; a name already in use gets a number. An alpha image is not included in the file. The preset buttons now sit on two rows with an icon each, and Copy and Paste settings are in the \u2026 menu.","w":["Brush tab \u203a Export, Import"]},{"g":"n","t":"Sidebar on the left","b":"The sidebar can now sit on the left side of the window. Tool dialogs, notices, the viewport action bar and the column's cards move with it, and the bottom toolbar re-fits to the space left over.","w":["Settings \u203a Theme \u203a Sidebar"]},{"g":"n","t":"16-bit clay","b":"Clay layers can now use 16-bit precision instead of 8-bit, for smoother surfaces and finer detail at about twice the clay memory. The choice applies the next time Klay starts. Existing scenes and clay stamps open in either mode with the same shape.","w":["Settings \u203a Preferences \u203a SDF"]},{"g":"n","t":"View and lens in the Viewport HUD","b":"The Viewport HUD can show the camera you are looking through and its projection. When the view sits on an axis, for example after snapping in orthographic mode, the line names it instead: Front, Back, Left, Right, Top or Bottom. A separate Lens line shows the focal length in millimetres, or the frame height in orthographic mode. View is on by default; Lens is off.","w":["Display \u203a Viewport HUD \u203a View, Lens"]},{"g":"n","t":"Pan speed","b":"Pan speed sets how fast the view pans, next to Orbit speed and Zoom speed. At 1.00x the surface stays under the pointer, as before. Absolute trackball keeps its own value.","w":["Settings \u203a Navigation & binding \u203a Speed"]},{"g":"n","t":"Invert stroke with Alt","b":"Invert stroke with Alt makes Alt + drag invert the brush instead of Ctrl, as in ZBrush. The other Ctrl shortcuts are unchanged. It needs a Navigation key other than Alt, for example V.","w":["Settings \u203a Navigation & binding \u203a Global navigation"],"n":"Option on macOS"},{"g":"n","t":"Radial Grid and Ground Disk saved with the scene","b":"Each scene now keeps its own Radial Grid and Ground Disk settings: colours, opacity, rings, thickness, Y offset, visibility and scale. Set as default in each card sets the values that new scenes open with, and Reset returns the card to them. Your current grid and disk become the default after the update.","w":["Room \u203a Radial Grid, Ground Disk"]},{"g":"i","t":"Retopology rebuilt","b":"Retopology has two modes, chosen at the top of the dialog. Smooth, the default, produces a closed, all-quad mesh whose edge loops follow the main edges and large forms of the sculpt, such as hat brims, cuffs and the rims of a base, and keeps thin parts such as a staff or a cane; it offers Target faces (35k by default), Smoothing and Adaptive, which places smaller quads where the surface curves, and uses all processor cores. Sharp keeps more of the sculpted surface and its creases, with the settings of the previous version, and now also returns quads only, with no triangles or n-gons. The progress bar shows five plain steps, from Reading your sculpt to Finishing.","w":["Outliner \u203a Mesh \u203a Retopology"]},{"g":"i","t":"Curvature sizing refines the sharpest line","b":"With Sizing set to Curvature, tessellation now places its finest edges on the sharpest part of the form, such as the bottom of a knife cut, including the edges that run along it. The edge size grows gradually away from it instead of forming a wide, uneven band.","w":["Brush tab \u203a Tessellation \u203a Advanced \u203a Sizing"]},{"g":"i","t":"Brush cursor and tessellation grid","b":"The density grid's colours, opacity and wire fade can now be set in Settings, for brushes with tessellation on as well as for the Tessellation tool. When Size follows pen pressure, the grid now ends at the light-touch ring, so the dotted full-press ring stays visible. The Clay brush's cursor now uses the brush cursor colours and shows the same pressure rings as the other brushes.","w":["Settings \u203a Brush cursor \u203a Tessellation"]},{"g":"i","t":"Viewport settings cards","b":"The cards opened from the viewport capsule (Symmetry, Display, Visibility, Wireframe, Stroke Sound, Focus and Raytracing) now share one panel-style card that follows the theme's panel colour and corner radius. Display settings are sorted into Render, Shadows, Mesh and HUD tabs, and related settings sit together in groups. In Symmetry, Topology is a choice in the Mirror across row beside Object, World, Bounds and Custom.","w":["Viewport capsule"]},{"g":"i","t":"Undo for light edits","b":"Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Y now undo and redo light edits: moving and aiming a light, exposure, intensity, colour and Kelvin, area and spot size, sky time and direction, and adding, duplicating or deleting lights. Each drag is one step, in order with your sculpt strokes. This covers the Lantern tool, its card, the Lighting tab, hold-S and the VR light grab.","w":["Lantern tool"]},{"g":"i","t":"Grab from outside the model","b":"A grab-type poly brush, such as Grab, Move or Snake Hook, pressed with its centre off the model now moves everything under the brush circle, through the whole model, as a Silhouette grab. Before, the press did nothing. The setting is on by default and can be turned off with Outside stroke is silhouette.","w":["Brush tab \u203a Brush \u203a Outside stroke is silhouette"]},{"g":"i","t":"Orbit and zoom around the point you click","b":"With Orbit around mouse point on, the point under the pointer is picked when an orbit, pan or zoom starts, and zooming now moves toward that point instead of the centre of the view. Switching objects with V, by click or by hovering, also sets that point, with either Orbit around mouse point or Orbit around stroke point on. With Orbit around stroke point, a click on any object, selected or not, also sets it.","w":["Settings \u203a Navigation & binding \u203a Behaviour \u203a Orbit around mouse point"]},{"g":"i","t":"Undo and Redo in the Shortcuts tab","b":"Undo and Redo are listed in the Shortcuts tab as fixed shortcuts. Other actions can no longer be assigned to Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+Y or Ctrl+Shift+Z.","w":["Shortcuts tab \u203a Actions"]},{"g":"i","t":"Smooth / Faceted shortcut","b":"Smooth / Faceted shading can be assigned a key in the Shortcuts tab. Each press switches the viewport between smooth and faceted normals. It has no key by default.","w":["Shortcuts tab \u203a Actions"]},{"g":"i","t":"Show terminal","b":"A new setting opens a window that shows Klay's log live while it runs, which helps when reporting a problem. It takes effect the next time Klay starts, and closing that window also closes Klay.","w":["Settings \u203a Preferences \u203a Terminal"]},{"g":"i","t":"Confirm before overwriting a brush preset","b":"Saving a brush preset that already exists now asks for confirmation before its saved settings are replaced. A new preset, such as a fresh duplicate, saves without asking.","w":["Brush tab \u203a Save"]},{"g":"i","t":"Search your sculptures, and a Start something new card","b":"The Sculptures page of the welcome screen has a search field. It shows only the sculptures whose name or folder contains what you type, and how many match. When the list is empty, the page shows a Start something new card that creates a new scene.","w":["Welcome \u203a Studio \u203a Sculptures"]},{"g":"i","t":"Exhibitions: curated order, featured work and latest from every artist","b":"On view now follows the gallery's curated order and opens on the featured work, shown as a wide banner. New in the Exhibitions tab now lists the most recent works from all artists, newest first, including works shared from an artist's own page. The curated selection is now called On view. A search field finds works by title, artist or number, and Featured artists and All artists can be searched by name, city or tagline, in the same places as on the website.","w":["Exhibitions \u203a New"]},{"g":"i","t":"Drag a material from its name","b":"In the Material tab, a material can now be dragged from its name as well as from its thumbnail. The thumbnail enlarges slightly when the pointer is over the row, and while dragging it is shown raised with a shadow.","w":["Material tab \u203a Scene materials"]},{"g":"i","t":"Icons on save, load, import and export notices","b":"The notices shown while saving or loading a scene and while importing or exporting a model now start with an icon, like the other notices above the toolbar.","w":["File menu"]},{"g":"i","t":"Export file names follow the outliner","b":"The export dialog now suggests the object's name as shown in the outliner, such as Head.obj, for every format. A group export uses the group's name.","w":["File \u203a Export"]},{"g":"i","t":"Save a brush as a new preset","b":"Save as in the Brush tab saves the current settings as a new preset under a name you enter, for Clay, Stamp, Poly and Mask brushes. The preset you started from keeps its own settings, including any unsaved changes.","w":["Brush tab"]},{"g":"f","t":"Tessellation: lowering the Density of a brush in Densify mode had no effect on the surface. Strokes now also reduce the mesh to the Density, as in Adaptive mode."},{"g":"f","t":"Tessellation: on a mesh with UVs, a stroke stopped refining after one level of subdivision even with Max subdivision Off. It now refines to the Density."},{"g":"f","t":"Tessellation: Decimate all left the triangle count unchanged. It now reduces the mesh, also on meshes with UVs, which it keeps. The card reports the result of Subdivide all and Decimate all, or the reason when they cannot run."},{"g":"f","t":"Clay: the Add stamp could leave small square holes scattered over the clay, most often after a large stamp or after erasing an object completely and undoing. The holes no longer appear, and the toolbar stamp now always shows the shape the brush adds."},{"g":"f","t":"Clay: Clay brushes below full Strength, such as the Elastique brushes, now sculpt on an empty layer on the desktop. Before, they added nothing until clay had been laid with the Add stamp."},{"g":"f","t":"An object locked in the outliner could still be moved, rotated and scaled with the Gizmo tool, including by dragging the object itself. A locked object now stays in place, and the Gizmo tool shows a notice instead. In a selection that mixes locked and unlocked objects, only the unlocked ones move."},{"g":"f","t":"Holding Ctrl+Shift to crop no longer shows the Add or Carve stamp for a moment, and after the crop a Clay or paint brush stays the brush it was instead of turning into the Add stamp. Paint brushes never show a stamp."},{"g":"f","t":"With Share size across brushes on, releasing Shift, for example after Shift+D to add a subdivision level, could set the poly brush to the Shift brush's size. The brush now keeps its size."},{"g":"f","t":"Snapping the view with Shift while orbiting no longer changes the brush size when the keys are released, whichever key you release first."},{"g":"f","t":"With Swap Ctrl and Alt on, Ctrl+Z could repeat the last stroke instead of undoing it. Undo and Redo now always use Ctrl, and Reapply last stroke has no shortcut until you assign one."},{"g":"f","t":"Custom navigation no longer disables the built-in mouse gestures. With Orbit on the right button, a right drag on the model still erases the mask, twists with Grab, turns objects in Move and Gizmo, and removes curve dots; on empty space it orbits. With Zoom on Ctrl + right drag, Ctrl+Shift crop, Grab scale, Fill, Zones and Draw Topo work as before. Shortcuts now refuses a navigation chord that would replace Invert stroke, Smooth, Crop or the brush size scrub."},{"g":"f","t":"Clay: the Projector brush can now start its stroke on a polygon mesh. Before, a stroke started on a mesh began on the view's centre plane, or on clay hidden behind the mesh. With Lazy mouse on, the stroke now ends at the depth under the brush rather than under the pointer, so it no longer stays flat."},{"g":"f","t":"In the orthographic view, patches of the model near the edges of the view no longer disappear, and models no longer switch to a lower level of detail too early. Display settings has a separate Ortho threshold, and Cluster threshold is now named Perspective threshold."},{"g":"f","t":"The sidebar tab tooltips no longer appear behind the Camera Monitor."},{"g":"f","t":"Outliner: an open group now leaves space below its last object, so that object no longer sits against the bottom edge of the group."},{"g":"f","t":"Curve tool: a sharp dot now makes a corner on curves with Smooth on. Before, the dot turned square but the curve did not change."},{"g":"f","t":"Material thumbnails of MatCap materials, procedural or image, now show the matcap instead of an incorrect ball."},{"g":"f","t":"Brush > Direction > Angle had no effect while Rotate with the stroke was on. It now turns each alpha print by that amount relative to the stroke, and it reads in degrees. Fixed angle no longer replaces the round brush cursor with the rake bar."},{"g":"f","t":"Import as separate layers now gives one layer per object and per loose part, as the Split tool does, for OBJ, FBX and Alembic files, and keeps quads as quads. Before, a ZBrush OBJ was cut apart along its polygroups, and an FBX or Alembic object made of several parts came in as one layer, and every layer was imported as triangles."},{"g":"f","t":"Ctrl+D no longer moves a new copy by the offset of an earlier duplicate. The offset is repeated only when you duplicate the copy you just moved, within five seconds; otherwise the copy is placed on the original."}]},{"version":"0.0.48","date":"2026-10-07","lede":"Render region raytraces only a part of the view; Color correct v3 works like Lightroom\u2019s develop panel; artists can publish their exhibitions from the Exhibitions tab.","highlights":["Render region","Artist pages and exhibitions","More functions for buttons","Fog over the backplate"],"notesUrl":"https://klaysculpt.com/releases/0.0.48","items":[{"g":"n","t":"Render region","b":"Render region limits raytracing to a rectangle over the view, and the rest of the view shows the normal viewport. Drag the handle below the rectangle, or its dashed frame, to move it, and drag its corners or edge handles to resize it; Shift keeps its proportions. A bar above the rectangle appears when the pointer is over it and sets the region\u2019s resolution (full, half, quarter or eighth), pauses or resumes it, switches the outside between Unlit, Raster and Dim, and closes the region. A paused region keeps its image and turns grey if the view changes.","w":["Lighting tab \u203a Raytrace \u203a Region render","Add function \u203a Display \u203a Render region"],"n":"Desktop only"},{"g":"n","t":"Artist pages and exhibitions","b":"Artists with a Klay licence open their artist page from the Exhibitions tab and manage it on klaysculpt.com: their profile, an optional year of birth, and their exhibitions. Featured artists are shown in the gallery\u2019s rail, and each exhibition shows its number of visitors.","w":["Welcome screen \u203a Exhibitions \u203a My artist page"],"n":"Licence required"},{"g":"n","t":"More functions for buttons","b":"The function picker offers 29 more functions for the sidebar, the viewport action bar and the radial menus. Display: Faceted shading, Wireframe, Ground grid, Orthographic, Raytracing, Cycle shading mode, Focus mode, X-ray selected and Viewport HUD. Symmetry: X, Y, Z, Radial and Edit symmetry plane. Object and levels: Align, Mirror +X / \u2212X, Flip normals, Group, Ungroup, Unparent, Frame selected, Level up / down, Delete higher levels, Flatten levels and Tessellation. Also Export OBJ (highest level) and Add camera. Toggles light up while they are on.","w":["Add function \u203a Display / Symmetry / Object / Topology / Camera"]},{"g":"n","t":"Fog over the backplate","b":"Composite volumetric renders the scene\u2019s volumetric fog in front of a camera\u2019s backplate image, so the plate sits inside the atmosphere instead of behind a flat layer. The plate\u2019s Depth sets how much fog is in front of it. Applies in Raytrace shading with scene fog enabled.","w":["Camera tab \u203a Image plane \u203a Composite volumetric"]},{"g":"i","t":"Color correct v3","b":"Color correct now works much like Lightroom\u2019s develop panel. Sections follow Lightroom\u2019s order: Light, Curve, Color, Grading, Effects, Detail and Grain. Clarity, Structure and Dehaze now take the whole image into account, so local contrast stays free of halos around large forms and Dehaze adapts to the haze in the frame. Clarity and Structure also accept negative values, which soften the image. Contrast, Highlights, Shadows, Whites, Blacks, Temp, Vibrance and Saturation use Lightroom-style responses, and readouts show signed values from \u2212100 to +100. Shift-drag a slider for fine adjustment; after clicking a slider, the Up and Down arrow keys nudge it while the pointer stays over it. The Shadows, Midtones and Highlights wheels are unchanged.","w":["Post tab \u203a Color correct","Camera tool \u203a Grade"],"n":"Clarity, Structure and sharpening are desktop only"},{"g":"i","t":"Shortcuts: swap Ctrl and Alt, mouse buttons","b":"Swap Ctrl and Alt exchanges the two keys everywhere: every Ctrl shortcut becomes Alt and every Alt shortcut becomes Ctrl, including Ctrl-click to invert a brush and Alt + drag to navigate. Any shortcut can also be set to the middle mouse button or the side buttons (Mouse 4 and 5), for example to open the radial hub with the middle button. A mouse button already used by a navigation chord is refused.","w":["Settings \u203a Navigation \u203a Global navigation","Shortcuts tab \u203a any shortcut"]},{"g":"i","t":"Curve tool: end tapers, profile grid","b":"Taper start and Taper end now narrow each end of a curve separately, each with its own length. The profile editor has an adjustable grid that points can snap to; hold Shift while dragging to place a point freely. The shortcut that removes a point can be changed in the Shortcuts tab.","w":["Curve tool \u203a Along the curve","Curve tool \u203a Profile","Shortcuts tab \u203a Tools"]},{"g":"i","t":"Stamp & Falloff: shape, then spacing","b":"The Stroke section is now part of Stamp & Falloff, ordered by the choices you make. Shape is Procedural (Circular, Box or Crease, each with its own settings below it) or Alpha. A single Spacing slider replaces the Polywire switch, Spaced stamps and Bead spacing: its far-left zone is Polywire, the smooth swept line, with its settings shown below it; the next zone is Continuous, a line of overlapping dabs; further right the shape is printed that far apart, in percent of the brush size, for every shape, up to ten times the brush size. Imprint, Direction and Dynamics follow, and the other technical stroke settings are grouped in Advanced stroke. Dynamics now has Taper start next to Taper end; Taper end works on polygon meshes: the stroke trails the cursor by the taper length and finishes it to a point after you release, and the Spacing preview shows the loaded alpha and every Dynamics setting. Each setting has an information button that explains it. Existing brushes keep their previous behaviour.","w":["Brush tab \u203a Stamp & Falloff"]},{"g":"i","t":"Pen pressure","b":"Poly brushes have a Pen pressure section. Size, Strength, Hardness, Smooth and Elastique each have a switch, a range from a light touch to a full press, and their own response curve. Settings \u203a Tablet adds an app-wide pressure curve, a threshold below which nothing is drawn, a full-at point and pressure smoothing. Existing brushes keep their previous response.","w":["Brush tab \u203a Pen pressure","Settings \u203a Tablet \u203a Pressure feel"]},{"g":"i","t":"Brush cursor settings","b":"A Brush cursor section sets the ring colours, the fade while stroking, the centre dot size and the system pointer. For brushes whose size follows pressure, the ring shows the light-touch size and a dotted ring the full-press size; a few dots keep the full-press size visible during a stroke.","w":["Settings \u203a Brush cursor"]},{"g":"i","t":"Orbit around mouse point","b":"A new navigation option orbits around the surface under the mouse when the orbit starts. Over empty space, the previous point is kept. It replaces Orbit around stroke point when turned on; F returns to the usual centre.","w":["Settings \u203a Navigation \u203a Behaviour"]},{"g":"i","t":"More than 8 lights","b":"A scene is no longer limited to 8 lights. Raytrace lights the scene with every light; the viewport shades the first 8. Lights beyond the eighth do not use a projector Source, an IES profile or Raytrace caustics. The Lantern light list now shows every light without scrolling.","w":["Lantern tool \u203a Lights","Lighting tab \u203a Lights"]},{"g":"i","t":"Lighting presets grow as you fill them","b":"Presets and Scene presets always show complete rows, and a new row of empty slots appears as soon as one in the last row is used. A scene is no longer limited to 12 Scene presets.","w":["Lighting tab \u203a Presets","Lighting tab \u203a Scene presets"]},{"g":"f","t":"After a Laser cut with Fill, the cap is now welded to the mesh, so smoothing across the cut no longer splits it open."},{"g":"f","t":"When an update is available, its Download & install button now always stays visible at the bottom of the welcome screen, and long release notes scroll above it."},{"g":"f","t":"With Raytrace on, changing the Room disk or a backdrop's parameters no longer makes the other objects disappear from the view."},{"g":"f","t":"Enabling Coat, Emission, or Subsurface on a material in the Raytrace view no longer produces a brief bright flash before the image settles."},{"g":"f","t":"Switching from Unlit back to Raytrace no longer occasionally drops instanced objects from the view."},{"g":"f","t":"With symmetry on, Gizmo \u203a Consider masking now poses each mirrored copy of the unmasked area about its own mirrored pivot, and a scale bead now scales along its own axis only."},{"g":"f","t":"On a polygon mesh with symmetry on, including topology symmetry, Ctrl+left-drag rotation and Ctrl+right-drag scaling with a Grab brush now apply to the mirrored side as well."},{"g":"f","t":"Holding X for a momentary Mask brush now switches instantly."},{"g":"f","t":"On polygon meshes, alpha brushes with Imprint or Spaced stamps keep the full detail of the alpha and use the same strength scale as a stroke; non-square alphas keep their proportions, and stamps along a stroke no longer smear."},{"g":"f","t":"With Orbit set to a mouse button without a modifier (for example the right button), pressing Shift during the orbit now snaps to the axis views."},{"g":"f","t":"Exhibitions now show only the mouse pointer, even when a clay stamp was selected before entering, and open with the artist\u2019s Smooth or Faceted normals setting instead of the visitor\u2019s."},{"g":"f","t":"In
